taken.title: Already linked to another member
taken.body: That LINE account is already linked to a different AIS Alumni account. Try again with another LINE account, or sign in with LINE to use that account.

cancelled.title: Linking cancelled

expired.body: Linking links and QR codes work for 10 minutes. Please refresh the page on your other device and scan the new code.
